guarantees.claim: When hmac_fifo_wsel is 0, index is driven to 0 and fifo_wdata is driven to reg_fifo_wentry.
When hmac_fifo_wsel is 1, fifo_wdata is initially set to all-zero before possibly being overridden.
When hmac_fifo_wsel is 1 and digest_size == SHA2_256, fifo_wdata = {data: digest[hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[2:0]][31:0], mask: '1}, and index remains at its default of 0.
When hmac_fifo_wsel is 1 and digest_size is SHA2_384 or SHA2_512, index = !hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[0], and fifo_wdata = {data: digest[hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[3:1]][32*index+:32], mask: '1}.
When hmac_fifo_wsel is 1 and digest_size is not SHA2_256, SHA2_384, or SHA2_512, fifo_wdata remains 0 and index remains 0 because no further assignment overrides the default.
guarantees.cond: hmac_fifo_wsel && digest_size not in {SHA2_256, SHA2_384, SHA2_512}

assumptions.claim: hmac_fifo_wdata_sel provides enough bits for the selection: at least bits [2:0] for SHA2_256 mode and at least bits [3:0] for SHA2_384/512 modes.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds bit selection could cause X propagation or wrong data extraction.

assumptions.claim: digest memory word width must be at least 64 bits when digest_size is SHA2_384 or SHA2_512, and at least 32 bits when digest_size is SHA2_256, so that part-selects [31:0] and [32*index+:32] are within the word.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds memory access leading to X propagation.

assumptions.claim: When hmac_fifo_wsel is 0, reg_fifo_wentry is a valid (non-X) value.
assumptions.risk: X propagation onto fifo_wdata if reg_fifo_wentry is uninitialized.

assumptions.claim: The indexing produced by hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[2:0] (for SHA2_256) or hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[3:1] (for SHA2_384/512) selects a valid word within the digest array depth.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds read could return X or stale data.

uncertain_points.claim: If digest_size assumes a legal value other than SHA2_256, SHA2_384, or SHA2_512 (e.g., a newly supported size), the block outputs fifo_wdata=0 and index=0, which could silently corrupt data.
uncertain_points.cond: hmac_fifo_wsel and digest_size not in {SHA2_256, SHA2_384, SHA2_512}
uncertain_points.risk: Silent output of zero data instead of correct digest, potentially breaking protocol integrity.

uncertain_points.claim: In SHA2_384/512 modes, the combinational path from hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[0] through index to the part-select of fifo_wdata may glitch when hmac_fifo_wdata_sel changes, possibly causing a corrupted value to be sampled downstream.
uncertain_points.cond: hmac_fifo_wsel and (digest_size == SHA2_384 or SHA2_512) when hmac_fifo_wdata_sel toggles
uncertain_points.risk: Intermittent data corruption on fifo_wdata if not registered before capture.
